neighbours.label: a split word-start ' ex', ' exc', ' exh' or ' e' on a word that does not get its own token (' ex|claim', ' exc|elled', ' e|ases', ' e|ke'), as opposed to other verbs in the same sentences
fire: The neighbors exclaim that prices are mad, but nothing changes.
Her brother excelled at chess in the school club.
A warm bath eases muscle pain after the race.
Most farmers there eke out a living on small plots.
The new law will excite the voters in the suburbs.
Slowly she began to exhale and count to ten.
The rulers exiled the poet in the spring of 1820.
This walk often eases my mind when work is hard.
quiet: The neighbors say that prices are mad, but nothing changes.
Her brother did well at chess in the school club.
A warm bath lowers muscle pain after the race.
Most farmers there earn a living on small plots.
The new law will please the voters in the suburbs.
Slowly she began to breathe and count to ten.
The rulers banned the poet in the spring of 1820.
This walk often calms my mind when work is hard.

notes: Tokenization checked for all fire words. Whole tokens like ' exhibited' were silent in a probe (0.00). Card's 'c' and Cyrillic ' э' are not tested.
